transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this review to get the information I need before making a disposition on the 480 castings from Cell 7 that are on quality hold. As we all know, we had an abnormal cooling event during yesterday's run, and the initial visual inspection came back clean with no visible cracks. However, before I can make a final call, I need to hear from three areas. First, from metrology: have we done any dimensional checks or non-destructive testing beyond the visual inspection, and what do the results show? Second, from maintenance: what's the status of the cooling system repair, and can it be completed during the planned production pause? And third, from production control: what's the impact on the machining department's schedule, and how long can they wait for my disposition? Let's go through these one at a time.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I completed a dimensional review of all 480 castings this morning. 312 of them meet the flatness limit of 0.30 mm or less, but 168 measure above 0.30 mm and will need to be reworked before they can be released. The full measurement report is finished but is still in the metrology report queue and hasn't reached your desk yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, on the maintenance side: my inspection of Cell 7's cooling system found that the cooling-fan belt is damaged and must be replaced before we can run another production batch. I confirmed with my maintenance technician this morning that the replacement takes exactly 2 hours. The work order hasn't been entered into the system yet, but the repair is straightforward and can absolutely be completed during the planned production pause.
transcript.speaker: A3
